Batch 44 is authored and ready for handoff. The A and B pages, 11 items, source coverage, proof contracts, cross-batch dependency evidence, and authoring notes are recorded.

I resolved the resampling wording conflict by limiting conditional IID ancestor indices to multinomial resampling; residual resampling uses dependent floor-plus-remainder counts. I also added the measure and measurability suppliers needed to justify the kernel RN lemma’s measure-determining step.

Checks passed: precheck (8 proof items), strict proof contracts (11 items, 44 citations), citation fidelity, proof layout (28 steps), rendercheck (13 files), focused dependency and content-policy checks, coverage checklist (23 harvested results), and source-fetch check (7/7). All 11 Step 1 records recheck closed and ready; these are authoring-readiness records, not independent approval.

Two run-wide checks remain outside this batch: item dependency levels report 14 empty page inventories and one unrelated mismatch (`ex-cylinder-gaussian-process-is-not-banach-valued`); the shared batch dependency artifact reports stale after manifest edits. Details are in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-44.notes.md). I left that owner-managed artifact unchanged.
